The '''Chanterelle''' is found via [[foraging]] in the [[Secret Woods]] in the [[Fall]], grown in [[The Cave|The Farm Cave]] if the Mushroom option is chosen, or produced by a [[Mushroom Log]].  It may also be found in the [[Ginger Island#Dig Site|Ginger Island Mushroom Cave]].

==Tailoring==
Chanterelle is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create an {{Name|Shirt015|link=Tailoring{{!}}Orange Shirt|class=inline}}. It is an orange dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the orange dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in [[dyeing]].
